description: React component for the Marketplace page of a career navigation application. It displays personalized opportunity recommendations, skill gaps, and roadmap insights, leveraging localStorage data to determine user context.

methods.name: safeParseRoadmapState
methods.description: Parses the roadmap state JSON string from localStorage, with error handling and validation.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number between a minimum (a) and maximum (b) value.

methods.name: completionSummary
methods.description: Calculates summary counts for milestones based on their status.

methods.name: countSkillGapsFromDeltas
methods.description: Derives counts of completed, in-progress, and missing skills from role plan deltas.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: Custom React hook that detects if user prefers reduced motion for accessibility.

methods.name: BadgePill
methods.description: Component rendering a styled badge element with tone and content.

methods.name: MetricCard
methods.description: Component displaying a label, value, and status badge with hover effects.

methods.name: OpportunityCard
methods.description: Component that renders an opportunity resource card with details and interactivity.
